scenes.title: NVIDIA NAT
scenes.sub: The NeMo Agent Toolkit: connect, evaluate, and profile agents across frameworks.
scenes.say: This is the NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit, or NAT.

scenes.heading: What it is
bullets: Instruments agents rather than being one
scenes.say: NAT is NVIDIA's open-source library for connecting, evaluating, and profiling agents across frameworks. It isn't an agent itself. It instruments the agents you already have.

scenes.heading: How it runs
scenes.say: You install it as a Python library and command line tool on your own machines. It wraps agents built in LangChain and other frameworks, and works with any model endpoint, including NVIDIA NIM.

scenes.heading: Timeline
scenes.say: It shipped as NVIDIA AgentIQ in March 2025 and was renamed the NeMo Agent Toolkit that June. The latest version is 1.9, from September 10, 2026.
